sloka: गिरिगह्वरसंलीनो यथा गर्जति मारुतः ।एवं जगर्ज बलवान् हनूमान् मारुतात्मजः ।। 5.57.28 ।।।।
transliteration: girigahvarasaṁlīno yathā garjati mārutaḥ ।evaṁ jagarja balavān hanūmān mārutātmajaḥ ।। 5.57.28 ।।।।

translations.english: (On seeing) Hanuman, who was resembling a heavy cloud approaching, the vanaras stood with folded hands.
